seo.description: Practice your English listening skills with our B2 pre-advanced comprehension test on News & Media. With instant feedback and transcript!

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Watch an interview with a journalist about news and media, and for questions 1 to 7, decide if the statements are True or False.
See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: He would watch more TV if there were no advertising.
He only reads from unbiased news sources.
He says that journalists nowadays don't enjoy doing research.
He implies that news in the past was more accurate than now.
He believes people nowadays don't want in-depth news.
He says the anchors covering the 9/11 attacks live appeared confused.
He was as shocked by the Capitol attack as he was by the 9/11 attacks.
